decisions.reason: Because Product A builds directly on the firm's established offer and the firm conducts its own R&D, it has the related knowledge to interpret results and improve it, and its continued own page in 2024 signals sustained commitment.

Although Product C is close to the firm's established offer and benefits from its R&D-related knowledge, its reduced website presence from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024 suggests some de-emphasis, yielding a slightly higher but still low probability of being dropped.

Similarly, Product E builds on the firm's established offer and related knowledge, but the shift from a dedicated page in 2023 to a mere mention in 2024 indicates weaker market attention, so it has a moderately low probability of being dropped.
